execution: physical XCTest touchscreen input; live Mapbox renderer reads; no injected callbacks

originalRunnerResult.reason: Runner auto-completed on the first generation-1 renderer POST immediately after remount, before post-remount child/source checks could be judged. Original runner output and manual report are retained unchanged.

live-child-button.evidence: Physical offset-child, post-style and post-remount child presses incremented child-click without map-click changes. The same-app post-remount check changed child-click 2 to 3 while map-click remained 5. The initial r7-read-child.json contained marker-click rather than child-click and did not establish this gate.

nested-scroll.evidence: A 20-point physical swipe wholly inside the 32-point viewport moved rows upward 10 points while the stationary label and renderer camera stayed fixed at [-122.34, 47.61], zoom 11.

live-drag.evidence: 650 ms stationary hold followed by continuous motion yielded live-start 1, live-drag 41, live-end 1 and a changed live position. Active-drag OS interruption used Settings and returned to the same app PID; readback showed live-start 2, live-drag 75, live-end still 1. Actual second-pointer cancellation yielded live-start 3, live-drag 91, live-end still 1. Separate real map pans changed camera afterward.

annotation-drag.evidence: Physical annotation hold/drag produced annotation-start 1 and annotation-end 1, changed its renderer position, and visibly moved the annotation child in r7-annotation.png.

offset-touch-bounds.evidence: Enabling offset moved live child bounds by (+24, -12) points; the relocated child remained pressable and a long drag changed its renderer position. Disabling offset moved bounds back by (-24, +12) points.

popup-follow-dismissal.evidence: Popup child press emitted popup-child. A real blank-area map pan moved the popup frame about 21 points while camera longitude changed. Its visible X incremented popup-close once; toolbar reopened it; remount left popup-close unchanged at 1. Post-remount read showed popup-open 3 and the popup visibly mounted.

source-propagation.evidence: Original-resolution feature-center taps: allowed case incremented source-click and map-click once; stopped case incremented only source-click. After style and remount, additional physical stopped taps incremented source-click while map-click stayed 5.

navigation-location.evidence: Physical Locate produced location 1 and renderer center [-122.33, 47.62]. Zoom-in read zoom 12; zoom-out read zoom 11.

style-remount.evidence: Physical style action changed style count 1 to 2 while feature 707, marker positions, popup, and child remained. Remount produced generation 1, load 2, style 3 and finite renderer state. Post-remount physical child and stopped-source taps were read with the same installed app/binary; counts rose to child-click 3 and source-click 4 while map-click stayed 5 and popup-close stayed 1.

host-accessibility.evidence: The native About this map button was physically opened and closed, and footer logo/facade scale/attribution/custom-control bounds were separated. However, the screenshot still shows the SDK multi-tick scale under the top-left Locate control. Full VoiceOver audit is unverified.

scale-units.evidence: Physical units control changed the facade scale from 2 km (76 points wide) to 1 mi (60.7 points wide). Footer logo and facade scale remain separately visible.

postRemountReadbackCollector.listener: temporary localhost collector on 8797; no app relaunch

note: Retrospective outcomes supplement, and do not replace, the original runner result. The first source tap used a preview-derived y-coordinate and missed; the corrected physical coordinate was derived from original screenshot pixels and produced the documented callback counts. The initial intended child tap reached the marker label; later actual child callbacks establish child isolation, not that initial input.
